text: Present findings clearly to avoid ambiguity or misinterpretation. Every word should be considered, questioned, and critiqued.
title: Clarity

text: Eliminate unnecessary words and focus on the most essential information.
title: Conciseness

text: Answer why this is important, why it matters, and why it deserves the reader's time. If it doesn't answer the "so what?", the product is lacking.
title: So What?

text: Tailor the content to meet the intelligence requirements and expectations of the primary (and secondary) audience.
title: Audience Analysis

text: Observations aren't analytical. Determine whether your assessment is analytical and forward-leaning, and not just an observation.
title: Avoid Observations

text: Check your biases. Check them again. Now have a peer or colleague review your work. Avoid any biases that could skew your analysis or impact your or your organization's reputation.
title: Objectivity
